title: Program Kit reusable consumer-owned C# build gates
intent: Provide reusable, deterministic mechanics for designing, establishing, activating, and verifying consumer-owned C# build gates while keeping Program Kit private policy off consumer-owned source and preserving explicit human authority over every selected or empty static-conformance disposition.
scope: A required StaticConformanceDisposition in every formal Program Kit-backed software design, with explicit human acceptance of either exact consumer-owned gate selections or an exact empty selection.

A human-started design-csharp-build-gate capability for composing standard baselines, narrow Program Kit public contract-conformance analyzers, and consumer-owned analyzers under exact profiles, activation, temporary exceptions, bootstrap, verification, compatibility, and migration.
Reusable Program Kit contracts, non-policy authoring primitives, direct opt-in build mechanics, compiler-backed testing, deterministic operations, and evidence for C# 14 on the .NET 10 SDK.
Implementation-plan semantics that establish and activate a required gate before dependent product work and execute its exact profile throughout implementation.
Preservation of the existing Orbyss.ProgramKit.CSharpGate and PKCS policy as Program Kit-private enforcement on Program Kit-owned source.
nonGoals: No reuse, export, packaging, or execution of Orbyss.ProgramKit.CSharpGate or PKCS policy on consumer-owned source.

No Program Kit ownership of consumer-specific rule meaning, diagnostic identity, project applicability, suppression approval, or acceptance decisions, and no consumer ownership of Program Kit public contract diagnostic meaning.
No automatic creation, implementation, activation, or approval of a consumer-owned gate.
No arbitrary script, Boolean expression, environment-variable switch, warning demotion, or command-line skip flag as an activation or temporary-disable condition.
No buildTransitive activation, runtime dependency, analyzer asset, authoring asset, test asset, capability, or provider adapter in a consumer runtime or package closure.
No speculative public metadata package, source annotation model, general compiler abstraction, assembly discovery, plugin system, or general process runner.
No migration of Program Kit's private gate onto the reusable mechanics without a separate reviewed equivalence design.
assumptions: The existing Program Kit private gate supplies useful source-inventory, compiler-participation, tamper, fixture, and evidence research but must be classified into private policy, public-contract candidates, optional recipes, standard baselines, and generic mechanics before any reuse.

Public Program Kit contract semantics that are statically observable should be single-sourced in narrow owner-controlled conformance analyzers or another exact conformance layer rather than copied into consumer-owned policy.
A consumer may need a predictable, temporary, bounded activation exception, so exceptions must be typed, digest-bound, human-authorized, evidenced, and fail closed.
A new or extended gate may require several bounded establishment work units; every such unit precedes dependent product mutation.
Passing a layered static gate is structural evidence and does not replace architecture, executable tests, integration evidence, or human semantic review.

sourceTruthAuthorities.governs: The requested ownership boundary, human authority, mandatory design and implementation-flow integration, evidence, terminology, and review-only scope.
The implemented Program Kit-private policy boundary and the mechanics that may be researched without exporting PKCS policy.

domains.purpose: Own universal deterministic development contracts, operations, projections, conformance mechanics, and provider adapters without owning consumer software policy.

vocabulary.meaning: A Roslyn analyzer assembly whose rule meanings, diagnostics, applicability, suppressions, compatibility, activation, and lifecycle are owned by the consuming software.

A narrow explicitly selected analyzer whose invariant and diagnostic meaning remain owned by one exact public Program Kit contract and which is activated only for consumers selecting that contract or profile.

The consumer-controlled composition, selection, activation, exception, suppression, and acceptance boundary over exact compiler baselines, Program Kit public contract-conformance analyzers, and consumer-owned analyzers.
The exact human-selected formal-design decision to reuse, extend, create, explicitly omit, or block on unavailable consumer-owned static enforcement.
A finite digest-bound mapping across exact projects, inputs, commands, implementation boundaries, and verification profiles that determines when each selected analyzer component must execute.
A bounded human-authorized typed condition that makes an otherwise selected gate temporarily inapplicable and produces a non-execution receipt; it is not a suppression or bypass.
The approved work that creates or extends, proves, binds, and activates a consumer-owned gate before dependent product mutation.

semanticModels.meaning: The formal design decision and exact evidence boundary for selected consumer-owned gates or an explicitly accepted empty selection.
semanticModels.invariants: Exactly one disposition exists. Missing, null, defaulted, or implicitly empty values are invalid. not-justified requires an exact empty selection, rationale, residual risk, and explicit human acceptance. blocked-unavailable blocks implementation.

semanticModels.meaning: The consumer-controlled composition of standard baselines, public Program Kit contract-conformance rules, consumer-owned rules, analyzer components, profiles, activation matrix, temporary exceptions, suppressions, bootstrap, selection lock, receipts, verification, compatibility, and migration for one C# build gate.
semanticModels.invariants: Only explicitly selected standard, public Program Kit contract-conformance, and consumer-owned analyzer components run on consumer-owned source. The private Orbyss.ProgramKit.CSharpGate never runs there. Public and consumer diagnostic semantics remain with their respective owners. Every non-execution is either outside exact applicability or justified by a valid typed temporary exception receipt; ambiguity and stale authority fail closed.

semanticModels.meaning: An implementation plan whose work-unit kinds, dependencies, selected gate locks, activation matrices, and verification profiles prove that gate establishment precedes affected product mutation.
semanticModels.invariants: reuse-existing requires a compatible lock at preflight. create-new and extend-existing permit only exact approved gate-establishment units until activation evidence passes. product and closure units execute the exact applicable profiles. not-justified requires the exact accepted empty disposition.

artifactDecisions.requestedOutcome: Represent the reusable consumer-owned C# build-gate extension as a validated canonical design and separate exact implementation plan.

executableBehavior.rationale: The review set grants no implementation, analyzer execution, gate activation, capability execution, or consumer authority.

valueLifecycle.rationale: Canonical design bytes are schema-validated, manually projected because no architecture renderer is registered, compared with the projection and plan, and digest-bound for human review.

agentRetrieval.rationale: The review set is addressed through explicit repository paths and exact artifact references.

agentProcedure.rationale: No capability, wrapper, hook, watcher, analyzer, build import, or autonomous procedure is created by this design.

humanCommunication.audience: The human Program Kit architecture reviewer and later consumer-software reviewers.
humanCommunication.decisionAuthorityBoundary: Only explicit human approval of the exact canonical design and implementation-plan digests authorizes implementation. Each consumer later approves its exact non-empty or empty static-conformance disposition.
humanCommunication.rationale: The extension changes architecture and planning contracts, build enforcement, capability behavior, and consumer authority boundaries.

generatedNavigation.rationale: No generated navigation artifact is required for the review set.

governance.provenancePolicy: The exact human intent and implemented Program Kit source truth govern; the rejected prior draft and implementation observations are research evidence only.
governance.digestPolicy: The review manifest binds exact canonical design, human projection, static-conformance candidate, and implementation-plan bytes; any change requires revalidation, new digests, and a new human decision.
governance.compatibilityPolicy: Changing ownership, disposition, activation, temporary-exception, bootstrap, receipt, runtime-isolation, operation, package, planning, or capability semantics requires a newly reviewed design version.
governance.migrationPolicy: Architecture v1 and Planning v2 remain readable through explicit migrations. New writers emit Architecture v2 and Planning v3 only after the corresponding work units pass.

dataHandling.redactionPolicy: The design contains no credentials, source payloads, private repository material, runtime paths, tokens, or analyzer execution output.
dataHandling.externalizationPolicy: Only committed review artifacts and exact digests may be shared.
dataHandling.ephemeralDataPolicy: Compiler temporary roots, build outputs, analyzer binaries, test workspaces, execution receipts, and local paths remain outside the design.

artifactDecisions.rationale: A canonical schema instance and separate plan keep the extension exact, reviewable, migration-aware, and non-executable until human approval.

security.policy: Build-gate mechanics validate controlled inputs, exact toolchains, analyzer participation, tamper state, and bounded evidence without claiming broader software security.
guarantees: Unknown or changed analyzers, inputs, condition kinds, exception parameters, receipts, locks, suppressions, or evidence fail closed.
exclusions: No claim that static conformance alone proves security, privacy, authorization, runtime safety, or semantic correctness.

authority.policy: Humans start design and implementation work and explicitly accept every exact selected or empty disposition, temporary exception, suppression authority, and plan.
guarantees: Capability availability, package installation, scaffolding, previous selection, silence, timeout, or generated files grant no authority.
exclusions: No silent gate creation, implementation, activation, disablement, renewal, approval, or product mutation.

secrets.policy: Gate definitions, locks, diagnostics, receipts, and durable evidence contain only reviewed identifiers, digests, classifications, bounded paths, and outcomes.
guarantees: The generic mechanics require explicit redaction policy and reject sensitive compiler arguments or source content in durable evidence.
exclusions: No credentials, tokens, secrets, raw source payloads, environment dumps, or unrestricted compiler logs become durable evidence.

persistence.policy: Only canonical contracts, consumer-owned source, exact locks, reviewed configuration, bounded receipts, and redacted evidence are durable.
guarantees: Bootstrap and verification own unique bounded temporary roots and prove teardown.
exclusions: No stale compiler output, analyzer cache, discovered package, mutable global registry, or ambient build state becomes source truth.

failure.policy: Definition, mechanics, analyzer build, attachment, inventory, source policy, suppression, activation exception, tamper, evidence, performance, package/runtime, toolchain, and internal-regression failures remain distinct.
guarantees: A failed, unavailable, ambiguous, stale, disabled, or substituted gate cannot be presented as an approved empty selection or a valid temporary exception.
exclusions: No Boolean success value collapses transport, tooling, public-contract policy, consumer policy, source, evidence, architecture, or human-decision failures.

concurrency.policy: Each bootstrap and verification execution owns an exact isolated root, nonce, compilation identity, receipt set, and evidence target.
guarantees: Parallel runs cannot share candidate outputs, receipts, temporary-exception use counts, or cleanup ownership.
exclusions: No shared mutable analyzer cache, global receipt root, or unscoped temporary state.

cancellation.policy: Cancellation propagates through bounded validation, compilation, fixture, and process templates and always enters owned-state teardown.
guarantees: Partial diagnostics, exception receipts, locks, and evidence are not promoted after cancellation.
exclusions: No claim that cancellation rolls back source edits or state outside the exact operation commit boundary.

observability.policy: Evidence identifies exact inputs, operation revisions, analyzer participation, applicability decisions, temporary-exception use, suppressions, diagnostics, outcomes, and teardown without becoming authority.
guarantees: Every applicable non-execution has one exact fail-closed explanation and receipt.
exclusions: No log, metric, receipt, generated report, or prior successful run approves a policy, suppression, temporary exception, or disposition.

compatibility.policy: Architecture, planning, gate contracts, schemas, public contract-conformance analyzers, consumer-owned analyzers, rules, diagnostics, profiles, condition kinds, matrices, locks, recipes, operations, packages, toolchains, capabilities, and consumer gates have independent exact clocks.
guarantees: Migrations and Version Map edges are explicit; mixed, partial, floating, or stale selections fail.
exclusions: No assembly version, package version, schema version, capability version, rule revision, or bundle inventory silently substitutes for another clock.

scenarios.intent: Produce exactly one accepted static-conformance disposition before finalizing a software design.
preconditions: The human has started formal software design and repository source truth is available.
steps: Enumerate statically decidable invariants and allocate each to its narrowest reliable enforcement layer.
Inspect exact available consumer-owned gate selections and any previously accepted empty selection.
When neither exists, ask the human whether to reuse, extend, create, or explicitly proceed without a consumer-owned gate.
If the human selects create or extend, run the human-started design-csharp-build-gate subflow and return its exact design reference.
Bind the exact human-selected disposition, gate selections or empty rationale, activation matrices, residual risks, and non-static claims into the final review set.
outcomes: The final design references one exact non-empty or explicitly accepted empty disposition.
failureOutcomes: Missing, null, defaulted, implicit-empty, unavailable, or unaccepted state prevents finalization.

scenarios.intent: Establish and activate a required consumer-owned gate before dependent product mutation and execute it throughout implementation.
preconditions: The exact architecture and implementation plan are human-approved.
The plan contains an exact create-new or extend-existing disposition and gate-establishment work units.
steps: Permit only the exact approved gate-establishment work units while the new compatible selection lock is absent.

Build each locally owned candidate twice in isolated clean roots, validate selected Program Kit public analyzer evidence, run the combined corpus, prove per-analyzer same-assembly participation, bind exact bytes, and activate direct build integration.
Prove automatic invocation and exact verification profiles before unblocking dependent product work.
Execute the selected gate at each applicable product work-unit, generated-output, and final-closure boundary.
Stop on policy ambiguity, gate defect, incompatible lock, changed activation, unapproved suppression, or invalid temporary exception.
outcomes: No affected product project is implemented without its required consumer-owned gate active under the exact approved matrix.
failureOutcomes: Absent, disabled, substituted, stale, inapplicable-by-ambiguous-condition, or failing gates block affected product mutation.

scenarios.intent: Compose one exact public Program Kit contract-conformance analyzer with one consumer-owned analyzer without exporting private Program Kit policy or duplicating public diagnostic meaning.
preconditions: The consumer selected the exact public Program Kit contract/profile and analyzer revision plus its exact consumer-owned analyzer definition.
Both components have compatible toolchain, project, input, command, boundary, suppression, receipt, and verification profiles.
steps: Validate the public rule and diagnostic against its owning Program Kit contract and lock its analyzer-only package.
Build and validate the consumer-owned analyzer under its consumer-owned rule catalog.
Reject diagnostic collisions, copied ownership, private PKCS attachment, unrelated public rules, runtime assets, buildTransitive activation, or profile ambiguity.
Attach both exact analyzers directly, execute the applicable combined corpus, and require one same-assembly participation receipt per analyzer and covered compilation.
Record distinct Program Kit public-contract, consumer-policy, and mechanics outcomes.
outcomes: Program Kit public semantics are checked consistently while consumer-specific semantics remain consumer-owned and the consumer retains gate selection and activation authority.
failureOutcomes: Missing owner contract, semantic duplication, unrelated rule activation, private analyzer leakage, collision, receipt failure, or runtime leakage rejects the composed gate.

scenarios.intent: Temporarily treat an exact selected gate scope as inapplicable only when one approved predictable condition is satisfied.
preconditions: A human-approved typed exception binds exact scope, condition kind and parameters, owner, rationale, residual risk, compensating verification, evidence, expiry or removal trigger, and renewal authority.
steps: Evaluate the condition from controlled digest-bound inputs.
Reject unknown, missing, ambiguous, changed, expired, widened, exhausted, forged, or unapproved-renewal state.
Run the exact compensating verification.
Emit a non-execution receipt bound to the compilation, evaluated inputs, exception digest, outcome, remaining lifetime, and use count.
Require removal, explicit renewal, or supersession at the recorded trigger.
outcomes: The predictable edge case is handled without pretending the gate ran or creating an ambient bypass.
failureOutcomes: Any invalid evaluation or missing evidence fails closed and blocks affected work.

statusClaims.claim: The design is ready for schema, semantic, terminology, projection, plan-trace, digest, and human validation; no implementation or consumer gate activation is approved.
